meta.source: frontend/src/styles.css in the Leva app (amex repo, branch redesign-brand)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the paper. Main view background, inputs' surroundings, the rest share on a field.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: One tone step down from bg: the app rail, list rows, budget rows, resting buttons and segments, panels. Separates without a line.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover on surface; the left-to-spend share on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text and figures on bg, surface and surface-2; the spent share; the mark's second block; the ink button's fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary notes on bg and surface only: dates, hints, table headers (6.3:1 and 5.6:1 in light). Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Magenta, the action: primary button fill, current nav marker, chosen trend bar, amounts owed, over-budget share, the mark's first block. One or two uses per screen. Text on bg (5.1:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and press; accent-coloured text on surface (6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Only for real form fields and table rows. Never to divide sections.

tokens.name: chart-rest
tokens.usage: Bars in a chart that are not the chosen one (the chosen one is accent).

tokens.name: field-1
tokens.usage: Periwinkle field: the month's total tile, the sign-in brand panel. Text on it in on-field.

tokens.name: field-2
tokens.usage: Lime field: the settlement tile, the import drop zone, success status, personal allocation tag. Text in on-field.

tokens.name: field-3
tokens.usage: Amber field: the budget total tile, alerts, the outlay allocation tag. Text in on-field.

tokens.name: field-4
tokens.usage: Cyan field: the drop zone while a file is dragged over it. Text in on-field.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text and shares on any field-1…field-4, in both themes.

tokens.name: member-1
tokens.usage: First household member's share, swatch and label. Always shown with the member's name.

tokens.name: member-2
tokens.usage: Second member. Order validated for colour-blind separation; never reorder.

tokens.name: member-3
tokens.usage: Third member.

tokens.name: member-4
tokens.usage: Fourth member (shares the accent's value; members past four repeat from member-1 and must be labelled).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One figure per screen: the month's total, the budget left. Fluid: clamp(56px, 6.4vw, 100px).

styles.name: head
styles.usage: View titles and the settlement verdict. Fluid: clamp(32px, 3.2vw + 21px, 64px). Two lines at most.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Block headings, statements under a figure. Fluid: 20–26px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose a row to change its category or how it's split.
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, form fields. Fluid: 17–19px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels, dates, hints, tags. The floor: nothing smaller.

tokens.name: space-share
tokens.usage: The gap that cuts the share: between parts of a share bar, segments, list rows, month stepper buttons. The brand's signature measure.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between items in a block; tile and row padding on a phone; the minimum page margin.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile padding; between a block heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop; tile padding at large widths.

tokens.name: space-block
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a view (fluid 36–64px). Clearly larger than any gap inside a block.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, fields, tiles, tags, the mark. Leva has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Only a modal dialog, which truly floats. Nothing at rest casts a shadow.
